data.narrative: The student successfully built, tested, and secured the Core API & CRUD endpoints for the URL Shortener monorepo. They implemented FastAPI routers for links management and public HTTP 307 redirects, enforced multi-tiered URL validation via Pydantic (rejecting 9/9 malicious XSS and open redirect payloads), and resolved an injected validation bypass break drill with hypothesis-driven debugging.

dimension_scores.observation: Selected prefixed redirect route (/r/{code}) to isolate public short code redirects from administrative routes (/links, /health).
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose Option A in DECIDE step to prevent routing collisions as the system grows.

dimension_scores.observation: Executed hypothesis-driven debugging to identify and fix the validator bypass in LinkCreate schema.
dimension_scores.evidence: Identified missing validation logic, restored LinkCreate schema rules, and verified 9/9 blocked abuse checks.

dimension_scores.observation: Enforced strict input validation boundaries to block stored XSS, open redirects, and userinfo credential tricks.
dimension_scores.evidence: Blocked javascript:, data:, //evil.com, backslashes, and @ userinfo tricks at the Pydantic boundary.

dimension_scores.observation: Implemented HTTP 307 temporary redirects with Location headers and async telemetry collection for click analytics.
dimension_scores.evidence: Extracted User-Agent/Referer headers and hashed client IPs for GDPR-compliant telemetry.

dimension_scores.observation: Articulated clear technical rationale across route design, validation boundaries, and verification proof.
dimension_scores.evidence: Answered all verification and reflection questions with strong technical depth and clear plain language.
